findings.current: twenty-eight days wouldn’t have been enough.
findings.defect: The English makes the prediction definite, while the source says it probably would not have been enough.
findings.rationale: The source uses 아마 (“probably”), which qualifies the prediction.
findings.replacement: twenty-eight days probably wouldn’t have been enough.

findings.current: They were in the safest, most discreet place I knew: my Inventory.
findings.defect: “I knew” makes the claim subjective and omits the source’s comparison to anywhere in the world.
findings.rationale: The source describes the Inventory as a place safer and more discreet than anywhere in the world, not merely the safest place the narrator knows.
findings.replacement: They were in the safest, most discreet place in the world: my Inventory.

summary: The assembled English is faithful overall, with two minor shifts in certainty.
